Retain a square 1254x1254 canvas with generous genuine transparent padding, ground-contact bottom at about (627,1120). Crisp readable stepped pixel contours, controlled discrete shading; no photo, glossy 3D, blur, huge pixel mosaic or painted checkerboard. Everything outside seed/sprout and the tiny soil pinch is real alpha transparency. No seed packet, bag, label, text, logo, icon frame, multiple versions or sprite sheet. One requested lifecycle stage only.
